01
The club

A club with history.

Most gyms sell you a membership. A community boxing club gives you a place to belong — and a coach who knows your name.

50Years of
community

Central Boxing Rotorua has been part of Fordlands life for decades. It is an amateur boxing club in the truest sense: young people learning the sweet science, adults getting fit, and a community that turns up for each other — in the gym and outside it.

The club trains at 24 Ford Road, Fordlands, under the Central North Island Boxing Association — the same association that has run amateur boxing across the region for generations.

✓

Amateur boxing, done properly

Real coaching, real technique, real respect — in a club affiliated with Boxing New Zealand.

✓

Young boxers welcome

A place for rangatahi to learn discipline and confidence, with coaches who have given decades to the sport.

✓

Community first

Fordlands families have kept this club going for fifty years. New faces are always welcome.

02
Training

What you’ll learn in the gym.

Boxing training that builds more than fitness — it builds people.

01

The sweet science

Footwork, guard, jab, combinations — the fundamentals of amateur boxing, taught properly from day one.

02

Sparring & bouts

For those who want to compete, the club prepares boxers for association tournaments — including Golden Gloves.

03

Fitness & discipline

Bag work, skipping, conditioning — get genuinely fit while learning respect, focus and self-belief.
